Target: NVIDIA (NVDA). NVIDIA designs accelerated computing platforms, GPUs and related software used in data centers, AI, graphics and gaming.

Focal announcement: DENZA Unwraps Smart Driving Options for N7 Model Lineup, Powered by NVIDIA DRIVE Orin.

Decision cutoff: 2023-09-27T23:59:59-04:00. Only information available before this cutoff is admissible.

Source: DENZA Unwraps Smart Driving Options for N7 Model Lineup, Powered by NVIDIA DRIVE Orin. Published: 2023-09-27. URL: https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/2023/09/27/denza-smart-driving-n7-model-nvidia-drive-orin.

Condensed source facts; other details are omitted: DENZA, the luxury electric-vehicle brand and joint venture between BYD and Mercedes-Benz, is debuting new intelligent driving features for its entire N7 model lineup, powered by the NVIDIA DRIVE Orin system-on-a-chip (SoC). The N7 series was introduced earlier this year as a family of spacious five-seater SUVs for commuters looking to sport a deluxe EV with advanced driving functionality. All N7 models can be equipped with the NVIDIA DRIVE Orin SoC for high-performance compute to simultaneously run in-vehicle applications and deep neural networks for automated driving. NVIDIA DRIVE Orin serves as the brain behind DENZA’s proprietary Commuter Smart Driving system, which offers an array of smart features, including: In addition to adopting accelerated computing in the car, DENZA is one of the flagship automotive trailblazers using the NVIDIA Omniverse Cloud platform to build and deploy next-generation car configurators to deliver greater personalization options for the consumer’s vehicle-purchasing experience.
